rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rig 'dzin dpal chen po'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥn mo:bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems ca

tei:div.tei:p: rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rig 'dzin dpal chen po'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo: bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus kun: bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang: yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs: thugs rje che ldan rnams la skyabs su mchi:

de nas theg chen smon sems ni/ ho: sngon gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis: bla med byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed ltar: bdag kyang mar gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro kun la: phan gdags slad du sangs rgyas bsgrub par bya: yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu la sogs pa'i: phyogs bcu'i skyabs yul rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: dngos su 'byor dang yid las byung ba yi: kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha' gang bas mchod: so thar byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang: rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'phags dang so so skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyis: rgyal sras spyod pa spyad la rjes yi rangs: mtha' yas 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur pa la: phan pa ji ltar 'tsham pa'i chos 'khor bskor: bskal pa bye ba bsam yas ji snyed du: 'gro ba'i don phyir mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs: bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams: 'gro kun byang chub snying po thob phyir bsngo: 'jug pa tshad med rnam bzhi bsgom/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro kun bde dang ldan: sdug bsngal kun bral bdag la smin gyur cig: sdug bsngal med pa'i bde dang mi 'bral zhing: chos kun mnyam nyid btang snyoms la gnas shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs tshogs zhing rnams: yi ge gsum gyi rnam pa yis: bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro la thim: sgrib dag byin gyis brlab par bsam: ༈ rang nyid skad cig gis las kyi he ru ka mthing nag rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba bigh+nān ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa sogs lan gsum//
